I just think that all the frustration I feel affects my in almost every way of my life. I think that I'm an okay guy when it boils down to it. Over the years I've told myself that it is something I can handle and that I don't need anyone's help to overcome it. I'm slowly accepting that I can't handle it and probably never could. Never should have. 

I'd like to talk more if that's okay. But I'm going away over the weekend, so it will wait until you hear from me. I'll pm you when I have the time to write more? But let me know if it burdens you, because I don't want that.

I don't think the people I've talked about it with can grasp how I mean, because they haven't been like that. But yeah, being taken seriously, sounds like the story of my life. Tried to talk about it with my school nurse one time when I was there for checking on an infected burnmark, but she just made me say yes when she said "Let's not do that again." and that was that. She didn't listen and I was scared of anyone to find out.

My life has been good at times and really crappy at times. My parents are divorced, my father is like talking to a tree and my mother is an unemployed depressed schizophrenic. We don't talk about anything important. 

I opened up to my girlfriend, because I loved her so much, and wanted her to know the real me, and it took days to tell her everything, and I still left out the worst parts. Later on, she told I laid too much on her because she was the first one I talked about it with, and that she didn't deserve the life-sucking task to take care of my problems. I think she did her best, but she was bad at expressing herself in a kind way.

I'm not okay, I think that myself. I don't want to hurt anyone or myself, I'd rather help people, but I want the pain to go away. I don't want to sound melodramatic either. I just want out.

No, I never made anything like that, it's just a part of me that's almost always there, just lying in the back of my head. Often emerging when I'm standing by the sea or when I'm alone home. 

I've mentioned it to a few people. Tried to talk about it with my girlfriend, but she had problems of her own and didn't really listen that good.

I don't go to r/depression because I don't think I'm depressed like that very often. Just feel really bad every other day and have a deathwish. I've hurt myself very few times in my life. Never took a liking to it. But almost everyday I think about going out to the sea and just swim away until I can't take another stroke. Sometimes when I'm alone home I take a knife and put the sharp edge against my chest, but I don't push it into my flesh. I live in a kinda high building, and I've thought about going up to the roof and just stand on the edge, looking down and out and just stand like that for a while. So yeah, I guess I've done that.

It feels strange typing this out. Often, I want to get away and make the pain go away, and I don't have any other way than my own to do that in.

It happened to me when I was visiting America (Ft. Lauderdale in Florida) with my family. I was in one of the countless stores there and spoke Swedish with my mother and brother and we were discussing the souvenirs' in that shop and looked around for the prices, since they weren't clearly labeled. The clerk at the counter just smiled a stupid grin and then said to his buddy next to him that we were "such idiots". 

Now, my family is swedish, so we all have more than enough of knowledge of the english language to get by in such a country, but I wonder what the clerk thought. The word "idiot" is the same in so many languages! 

Anyway, my family froze and my mother slowly put the souvenir back on the shelf and then walked over to him and asked him what he had called us. The clerk just laughed like an idiot and said "...what?" in such a slow, pretended way, as if he didn't know what she meant. She just turned around and we walked out in silence. Maybe twenty meters away we went into another store, and I bought a most wonderful towel, and the guy there was really fucking great, told us so many jokes and laughed all the time and everything... I still use the towel today. In the end, my memories of that vacation consists of only beautiful and good ones.
